_note: Skin layers of wounds (characters.md §7). A cut is one of five profiles (straight, bowed, S, hooked, ragged: points along u, offset v as a share of the length), placed at one of the head's places with a length, angle (degrees) and width. It is drawn as a pale ribbon with a thin shadow on one lip and a highlight on the other, so it reads as a trough; red while fresh, pale by the third year, never gone; puckered where it healed. Brow and beard hairs rooted in its band give way. Forms that change (a broken nose, a notched lid) are masters of their own parts.
